evidence.where: arXiv v1, Section 1, page 1: "we extend the Mixture of Experts to use a different gating network at each layer"; the model is cited as ref. [4], Jacobs et al.
arXiv v1, Section 1.3, page 3: "Our work builds on this use of MoEs as a general purpose neural network component", after citing Eigen et al. (2013)
Section 2.2, page 4: "The Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layer used in our model is based on [16]"; ref. [16] is Shazeer et al.
Section 2.1, page 3: "This formulation is similar to the GShard architecture [21]"
Section 3.2, page 12: applies "64-way Expert Parallelism (EP) (Lepikhin et al., 2021)"; Section 2.1.2, page 8, compares: "Compared with traditional MoE architectures like GShard"

focal.note: Sparsely-Gated MoE’s arXiv v1 says it builds on this use of MoE as a network component

notes: Dates. Adaptive Mixtures: the paper prints only 1991; Crossref gives 1991-02 and Semantic Scholar 1991-03, so the year is used. The paper says the idea was first presented at a summer school in 1988. Sparsely-Gated MoE: a version was public on OpenReview as an ICLR 2017 submission by 2016-11-13 (Wayback capture; the ICLR deadline was 2016-11-04), before arXiv v1 of 2017-01-23. Nothing opened gives the first day, so the year is used. That version lists six authors, arXiv v1 adds Geoffrey Hinton, and later papers cite the work as 2017. The sentence quoted for the link from Deep Mixture of Experts is in arXiv v1; the 2016 version cites Eigen et al. as related work without it. Mixtral: the announcement is dated 2023-12-11, and Mistral AI posted a magnet link on X on 2023-12-08 (read through a mirror, because x.com could not be opened), so the month is used. DeepSeek V3: the DeepSeek-V3-Base page was public on Hugging Face by 2024-12-25 (Wayback capture), the announcement is dated 2024-12-26 and arXiv v1 2024-12-27, so the month is used. The timeline item is dated 2024-12-26. Names follow the timeline glossary (DeepSeek V3); the paper prints DeepSeek-V3. Mixtral also uses the top-K gating it cites to Shazeer et al. (Section 2.1, page 2, ref. [28]); that line is left out to keep the chart readable.
